definitions.explanation: Leaving a place to begin a journey or trip.

examples.english: The departure was delayed due to bad weather, so we had to change our plans.

notes:
{出発|しゅっぱつ} means departure - the act of leaving or setting out on a journey.

WORD FORMATION:
{出|しゅつ} (exit, leave) + {発|はつ} (depart) = departure

GRAMMAR:
Used as both noun and する verb: {出発|しゅっぱつ}する (to depart)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出発|しゅっぱつ}する: to depart, leave
- {出発|しゅっぱつ}{時間|じかん}/{時刻|じこく}: departure time
- {出発|しゅっぱつ}{日|び}: departure date
- {出発|しゅっぱつ}{点|てん}: starting point (also figurative)
- {出発|しゅっぱつ}ロビー: departure lobby
- {出発|しゅっぱつ}ゲート: departure gate

TRAVEL EXPRESSIONS:
- {定刻|ていこく}に{出発|しゅっぱつ}する: to depart on schedule
- {出発|しゅっぱつ}が{遅|おく}れる: departure is delayed
- {出発|しゅっぱつ}の{準備|じゅんび}をする: to prepare for departure

ANTONYM:
{到着|とうちゃく}: arrival (opposite direction of travel)

FIGURATIVE USE:
{新|あたら}しい{出発|しゅっぱつ}: a new start/beginning
